description: ListingForgeAI looks up product information from an EAN barcode, MPN code, or product name and returns a structured product card with title, description, technical specifications, brand, and image links. Results are delivered as a downloadable Excel file. Processing is asynchronous — the app starts a task and reports progress until results are ready. A ListingForgeAI account is required.
